messages:
oliver_support: Customer acme-inc reporting tool-call args arrive truncated when using streaming responses. tool_name=payment-authorize, args JSON ends mid-object -> JSON parse error on their side (400). request_id=req_0a1b2c

maria_ops: Do we have the exact client payload + gateway logs? any proxy in front of them?

oliver_support: They attached a HAR and example server-sent events stream. Key snippet they pasted: 
```
data: {\"tool\":\"payment-authorize\",\"args\":{\"amount\":100.0,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"metadata\":{\"order_id\":\"ord_12345\",\"notes\":\"Gift wrap, deliver after 5pm\"}

// next SSE chunk

data: \"special_instructions\":\"leave at back door\"}}
```
Note the JSON braces split across SSE chunks, the second chunk starts with a bare string field. Customer says their SDK treats that as end-of-stream and attempts parse -> fails.

tia_repro: Reproduced locally with curl --no-buffer sending chunked payload + server keepalive every 2s. When chunk boundary splits in middle of an argument string we get exactly the same error. Repro steps: 
1) Start a small proxy that injects a 
`\r\n` keepalive every 2048 bytes.
2) Send a long args JSON for a tool call via our /v1/chat streaming endpoint.
3) Observe SSE frames where a data: line is split.

sam_dev: Can you paste the proxy logs for req_0a1b2c? specifically the raw bytes around the boundary. Also, what HTTP version was the client using (1.1 vs 2)?

oliver_support: Client used HTTP/1.1. Proxy is a third-party CDN that does keepalives (customer provided). Logs: 
```
[proxy] 10:21:03 TX chunk(2048) ...\n[proxy] 10:21:03 TX chunk(2048) ...\n[proxy] 10:21:04 TX chunk(128) : \"special_instructions\":\"leave at back door\"}}
```
Proxy cut the SSE data:line across chunks; our SSE emitter wrote a single line but the proxy re-chunked mid-line.

sam_dev: Our SSE implementation should treat each newline-terminated 'data:' line as atomic for higher-level parsing, but if the transport splits it, consumer libs reassemble. The problem is our streaming toolcall assembler expects the entire JSON to be delivered in a single uninterrupted data: block. That's brittle.

kevin_infra: Could be that our server flushes partial buffer on keepalive. We need to ensure we always end SSE \"data: \" lines with \n\n and not flush mid-line. Also confirm Content-Length vs chunked behavior.

maria_ops: Customer is blocked; billing impacted. They asked for a short-term workaround. Any suggestions?

sam_dev: Short term: advise customer to disable CDN keepalive or enable HTTP/2 which coalesces frames differently. Also suggest increasing client-side parse tolerance to accept concatenated SSE fragments (reassemble per message id).

tia_repro: For long-term, I filed an issue to change emitter: ensure we buffer and emit complete data: lines (coalesce until we append a terminating \n). Patch draft: 
```js
// pseudo
streamBuffer += nextChunk;
let lines = streamBuffer.split(/\r?\n/);
while (lines.length > 1) {
  emit(lines.shift() + "\n");
}
streamBuffer = lines[0]; // partial tail
```
This will keep partial tails until completed.

eng-bot: Deployed canary 2 -> eng-runtime/service-streamer v1.12.3-canary in us-east-1 for coalescing fix. Monitor traces for req_0a1b2c pattern.

kevin_infra: Rolling to eu-west-1 canary next. Please add synthetic test that forces chunk boundary at multibyte/quote positions.

oliver_support: I shared the repro steps and the HAR with the customer and proposed the HTTP/2 workaround + ETA for fix. Ticket INC-2026-57 opened. Customer appreciated quick turn. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: Closing loop here, will update after canary metrics. Thanks all.
